description: The plot illustrates the performance of different model variants on the HateXplain dataset, comparing their precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and has a categorical scale, with five distinct model configurations: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)", has a linear scale, ranges from 58 to 66, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays three lines: a purple line representing precision with a solid line style and circle markers, a blue line representing recall with a solid line style and circle markers, and a brown line representing F1-score with a solid line style and circle markers. The purple precision line starts at 65.49 for the full model, decreases to 61.06 for "w/o Prompt", increases to 63.7 for "w/o Augmentation", further increases to 64.06 for "w/o Attention", and reaches 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The blue recall line begins at 65.78 for the full model, drops to 59.64 for "w/o Prompt", peaks at 62.63 for "w/o Augmentation", declines to 59.17 for "w/o Attention", and ends at 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The brown F1-score line starts at 65.56 for the full model, decreases to 60.16 for "w/o Prompt", rises to 62.22 for "w/o Augmentation", falls to 59.67 for "w/o Attention", and concludes at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
